symptom_observed.scope: the published repository e-mudao/rnd-workflow-team-skills, whose tree still carries the pre-fix LICENSE
symptom_observed.contradicts: README.md, README.zh.md and CITATION.cff all claim MIT

root_cause_candidate.observation: The root LICENSE was the only file of its kind carrying extra text: its first 21 lines were byte-identical to the 11 skills/rnd-team-*/LICENSE copies and the sole difference was the trailing 'Scope of this file' paragraph.
root_cause_candidate.hypothesis: That appended paragraph pushed the MIT matcher below its threshold.
root_cause_candidate.status: Hypothesis, not proven. licensee could not be installed locally: rubygems.org returned repeated connection resets ('too many connection resets'), so GitHub's matcher behaviour was not reproduced.

fix.license: Root LICENSE replaced with the verbatim MIT text, byte-identical to all 11 per-skill copies (sha256 f1a8330b6f78922b753b48cdf25dbfaf36f45d099c13a8b29227afa007ef5c33, 1082 bytes).
fix.notice: The explanatory paragraph moved to NOTICE (719 bytes), with 'relavant' corrected to 'relevant' and an explicit note that the statement is not itself a license term.
fix.readmes: The license sections of README.md and README.zh.md now link NOTICE.

effect_on_checked_metric: The checker's local_links count rose from 143 to 145 because each readme gained one NOTICE link; skills (11), source digests (32) and the pass verdict are unchanged.
confirmation_boundary: GitHub's detection of the new LICENSE is only observable after this commit is pushed; it cannot be confirmed from the local checkout.
